reviewed_obligations.result: touchStreamAllowed, hardware-drag rejection, ring capture/ended return, pointer HUD/tool capture/ended return, ordinary finger/flythrough return all precede the precision suffix and are byte-exact. Reaching modified suffix entails frozen gestureUsesPencil true. All code outside the two replacements is byte-exact, including indirect, two/three-finger, direct/indirect pinch, hover, hardware registration and accepted UI/ring code.

Pan recognizer touchesBegan acquires pencil_paint_origin once for a fresh single Pencil touch at its physical origin, excludes captured ring/HUD and uses pencil_paint_at_start excluding ring/navigation/non-paint regions, before superclass delivery. Getter returns this saved value; movement does not replace it. PencilPaintContact.valid checks nonzero serial/generation/region only. New predicate intentionally does not query current mode, current presentation, liveness or hit map.

Cached relative translation and cache update remain in original order. Valid frozen paint contact prevents only this precision suffix PAN_GESTURE append; cursor motion, coordinates and tablet snapshot remain. Invalid/unsupported Pencil keeps exact original nonzero pan+cursor sequence. Zero translation behavior unchanged. A frozen tagged contact remains suppressed after stale/retired/mismatched identity or expired presentation, so generator rejection of pointer packets cannot leak an untagged trackpad pan from this suffix.

Existing Ended/Cancelled/Failed block and single LEFT_BUTTON_UP append remain. Valid paint contact sets cancelled false for Ended and true for Cancelled/Failed; invalid contact retains original false terminal semantics. No extra synthetic release, translation, token, liveness test or recapture is introduced.

Generator body unchanged. Pointer packets compare full serial/generation/region/origin_x/origin_y tuple with an actually enqueued down; once down exists matching terminal does not require live presentation. Before down, expired/retired contact or any tagged up is refused. Down ownership is stored only after GHOST down enqueue; terminal retires serial and clears tuple. Foreign/repeated packets cannot release the current replacement lease. This source review establishes the existing gates, not all UIKit callback sequences.

Existing cancellation emits one cancelled up only when actual tagged down was enqueued, using saved tuple/location/tablet before invalidating recognizers. Candidate changes none of this. Existing invalidated stream returns early; tagged delayed packets that still reach suffix cannot produce paired navigation.

reviewed_obligations.area: WM cancellation versus ordinary native release
reviewed_obligations.result: Unchanged generator passes cancelled into GHOST button; unchanged WM conversion sets WM_EVENT_IS_POINTER_CANCEL on cancelled up. Existing admitted original-owner Dispatch plus flag enters ot->cancel and OPERATOR_CANCELLED|PASS_THROUGH instead of ot->modal. Ordinary Ended remains unflagged and can reach native modal release/paint_stroke_line_end. Mode cancel behavior stays mode-specific; generic paint_stroke_cancel calls stroke_done. No universal rollback, geometry or Undo promise follows.

Exact one-file two-predicate diff changes no ring choices, names, styles, geometry, static UI assets, other source sections, or event-generator/navigation policy. The nine accepted Base actions remain inherited from verified source; this is literal scope preservation rather than fresh device UI acceptance.
